name: Sicilian Defense
description: The Sicilian Defense is a popular chess opening starting with 1.e4 c5. It leads to sharp, asymmetrical play where Black fights for the center using the c-pawn.

name: French Defense
description: The French Defense starts with 1.e4 e6. Black prepares to challenge White's center with d5. It leads to closed, strategic positions.

name: Ruy Lopez
description: The Ruy Lopez starts with 1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.Bb5. It is one of the oldest and most thoroughly analyzed chess openings, focusing on classical center control.
